channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: How a Bridge Delivers Tokens Across Networks
item.description: A cross-chain route can deliver a token your wallet’s network does not issue by moving value between chains and settling a destination asset or representation.

item.title: Diagnose a Pending BTC-to-ETH Bridge Transfer
item.description: A pending BTC-to-ETH bridge transfer can stall at Bitcoin confirmation, bridge verification, or Ethereum delivery; identify the stage before retrying or paying again.

item.title: How much should a treasury bridge to meet a deposit minimum?
item.description: If your treasury needs to meet a protocol’s minimum deposit on another chain, bridge enough of the required asset to clear that minimum after conversion…

item.title: Why a crypto bridge transfer stays pending
item.description: A bridge transfer can stay pending while the source chain confirms it, a bridge relays its message, or the destination chain executes it; each stage needs a different check.

item.title: Ledger tightens reseller rules after implanted wallets steal crypto
item.description: Ledger is changing how resellers store and sell its wallets after a hidden hardware implant was linked to crypto theft, exposing risks beyond device software.

item.title: USDC Arrived After a Bridge? Check the Token Before You Use It
item.description: A bridge receipt is only the start: trace the source and destination transactions, then verify the network, token contract and amount before using USDC in your wallet.

item.title: A Cross-Chain Swap Is Slow? Check Each Stage
item.description: A cross-chain swap moves through source confirmation, protocol processing and destination delivery. Check each stage to see where it is waiting and what to do.

item.title: How Cross-Chain Swaps Settle Across Two Blockchains
item.description: A cross-chain swap moves value through source-chain execution, a bridge or solver, and destination settlement, with timing and failure rules set by the route.

item.title: How Cross-Chain Minimum Output Guarantees Work
item.description: A minimum output sets the least amount a destination-chain swap may deliver; if the route cannot meet it before expiry, the transaction should fail instead.

item.title: Cross-Chain Swap Receipts: Check Both Chains
item.description: A cross-chain swap has a source transaction and a destination execution. Check both receipts, match the route, and confirm the final token reached the right wallet.

item.title: How Treasury Teams Should Set Cross-Chain Slippage
item.description: Set cross-chain slippage by route leg, liquidity and settlement time, then enforce a minimum received amount and review failed fills.

item.title: ASIC proposes custody and trading rules for Australian crypto platforms
item.description: ASIC has proposed custody, trading and financial standards for crypto platforms as Australia prepares a new licensing regime, with feedback open until Nov. 27.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Transfers Take Time
item.description: A cross-chain transfer has separate source-chain, bridge and destination-chain steps; each adds time, so users can locate a delay before retrying or sending again.

item.title: What a Cross-Chain Swap Quote Actually Compares
item.description: Cross-chain swap quotes combine the amount delivered, fees, slippage, route and execution risks; comparing those parts shows which offer fits the transfer.

item.title: Payward agrees to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank
item.description: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, adding a route to EU deposits and lending for Kraken customers if regulators approve the deal.

item.title: Four steps to estimate a cross-chain swap
item.description: Estimate a cross-chain swap by tracing the route, destination price and every fee, then compare the quoted minimum with the amount you need to receive.

item.title: StarkWare opens OffMarket for more private Polymarket trading
item.description: StarkWare opened OffMarket to Polymarket users, routing deposits through Starknet’s shared privacy pool while trades stay public and deposits remain capped.

item.title: Solana schedules Alpenglow for Oct. 21, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana will activate Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with direct validator voting that targets 150-millisecond finality and changes what blocks count.

item.title: How to Replace RenBridge for a Cross-Chain Transfer
item.description: Replacing RenBridge starts with identifying the asset and destination, then checking whether the route bridges, swaps or does both before you sign.

item.title: Ledger says CryptoBilis devices sent recovery phrases over LTE
item.description: Ledger says an implant in some CryptoBilis-sold devices read 24-word recovery phrases from screens and sent them over LTE, exposing wallets beyond Ledger’s software.
